items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Lily had signed the contract with Randy and we would not be able to get rid of it... Zutty couldn't stand the pianist... try to put the blame on Randy.

ctx.x: During my stay in Germany, Lily had sent me a letter, saying that she had engaged Zutty Singleton to make the tour with me, that she was organizing. I was not real happy about the deal, although I liked Face, as he was called by everyone that knew him well. I was certain that he would be a very disagreeable person to get along with when it came to working with him. But we were stuck and needed a drummer, so that was that!

Later, while still in Germany Lily wrote me and said that she had received a notice that Jimmie "Slim" Rodgers had died suddenly. Se had heard about a young Canadian Negro pianist that was playing in a club in Paris and asked Zutty and his wife Margie to come with her to hear this pianist and let her know if he thought the fellow was good and would be alright for our band. Afterwards, Zutty said that he liked the way this fellow played and that he thought he would be O.K. Lily told me his name was Randy Downs. He…
So Lily had a talk with Randy and he was willing to make the tour. She drew up a contract for him and Zutty and they both signed.
